answer_1.quote: We propose the Audio Description Question Answering (ADQA) benchmark... a multiple-choice QA framework... that evaluates ADs of few-minute long videos.

answer_2.quote: Classically, ADs are evaluated using CIDEr which compares n-grams between the generated and reference ADs.

answer_3.quote: We use a common prompt and LLM (Gemini 2.0 Flash) to perform all evaluations in our work... The LLM is prompted to answer each question independently.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation with 8 participants covering both question generation and answering stages.
answer_4.guideline: Users were shown: (i) the question generation context; (ii) the generated question and options; (iii) the answering context; and (iv) the chosen answer, and its rationale.
